description: This PHP class PathLocator computes various filesystem paths needed for staging code changes in a Drupal project, including project root, vendor directory, web root, and staging directory, utilizing Drupal core interfaces and Composer class loader.

classes.name: PathLocator
classes.description: A class for determining filesystem paths related to a Drupal project, including project root, vendor directory, web root, and staging directory.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing app root, config factory, and filesystem dependencies.

methods.name: getProjectRoot
methods.description: Returns the absolute path of the project root directory.

methods.name: getVendorDirectory
methods.description: Determines and returns the absolute path of the vendor directory by inspecting registered class loaders.

methods.name: getWebRoot
methods.description: Returns the relative web root path from the project root.

methods.name: getStagingRoot
methods.description: Returns the absolute path where staging directories should be created, based on site UUID.
